benefits.title: Students can pursue wider ambitions within their formal degree
benefits.statement: Students can access a broader range of learning opportunities aligned with their purposes and future ambitions, including experiences that cross or extend beyond their discipline. Placing these opportunities within the time, credit and recognition structures of the degree makes participation more equitable and ensures that meaningful experiential learning can count as part of formal study.
benefits.successLooksLike: Students from different backgrounds can use recognised pathways, including sandwich years and the shared experiential-learning capstone, to undertake and make sense of ambition-aligned learning without participation depending entirely on discretionary time outside formal study.

benefits.title: Programmes can offer sandwich years and recognised near-curriculum learning with less bespoke effort
benefits.statement: Shared policy, module, approval and administrative routes allow programmes and faculties to offer formally recognised learning without repeatedly creating bespoke structures. The Year 1 sandwich-year model and Level 6 capstone provide the first reusable products through which this simplification can be demonstrated.
benefits.beneficiary: Programme teams, faculties, academic governance and professional services
benefits.benefitType: institutional efficiency and reusable academic provision
benefits.successLooksLike: Programmes can adopt or adapt common routes with materially less local policy, validation and administrative design, while legitimate disciplinary variations remain possible.

benefits.title: King's gains a coherent route for formally recognising wider learning
benefits.statement: The University gains a reusable academic and regulatory architecture for learning that sits between the disciplinary core and extracurricular participation. This creates a stable route through which future experiential, interdisciplinary and cross-cutting provision can be governed, assured and formally recognised without multiplying disconnected institutional mechanisms.
benefits.benefitType: academic architecture, governance and scalable provision
benefits.successLooksLike: The sandwich-year and capstone products are implemented through common institutional routes, learning from them informs later decisions, and new near-curriculum propositions are assessed against a coherent architecture rather than starting from a blank page.
